title: 第21章 居心不良第22章 电动小马臀
content_zh:
肖冰邪邪一笑，道：“怎么？吃醋了，我看她的屁股挺大也挺翘的，这样的屁股自然想拍一拍。”
“哼，难道我的不大不翘吗？”姜凤装作不满地哼了一声。
肖冰拍了一下姜凤的屁股，这才道：“当然是你的最翘了，不然，我怎么让你跟在我身边呢？今晚让我用力拍一拍。”
“你讨厌……”
“是吗？前几天你可不是这样说的。”
“我怎样说的？”
“你说老公，用力用力。”
“你……不理你了。”
……
张逸风来到三楼，很快便找到了666包间，也算轻车熟路。
张逸风象征性地敲了敲门，随后推门而入。
包间里，不知道谁正扯着个嗓子唱死了都要爱，那声音真是强j了张逸风的耳朵。
还好，他进来没多久，这强j人耳朵的声音变止住了。
“张逸风，你怎么来了？”
章笑天惊讶的声音传来，拿着话筒的人，正是章笑天。
“张逸风来了？来，喝酒，喝酒。”
沙发上，贺娅娇也开口了，她躺在沙发上，哪怕包间里灯光很暗，张逸风也看得出来她的确是喝多了。
贺娅娇的旁边，坐着两位男子，这两人张逸风虽然不熟，却还是知道是谁。
杜少，杜渐。
齐少，杨量齐。

这两人都是航阳市本地人，这个包间里，就属这二人能量最大。其余还有两个男人，张逸风就不认识了，或许是这两人的朋友或者小弟。
这几个男人，正在合起伙来灌贺娅娇的酒。
贺娅娇明显已经不胜酒力，她看见张逸风，连起身都有些困难，最终踉踉跄跄地去到了张逸风身边。
“张逸风，你不是说你不来吗？你个讨厌鬼，你来干什么啊。不过，你来得正好，喝……喝酒！自罚三杯。”
张逸风眉头微微皱起，一把扶住了走路摇摇晃晃地贺娅娇，淡淡道：“时间不早了，你也喝的差不多了，该回家了。”
贺娅娇闻言皱起了眉头：“你不喝酒？那你来干什么，我回不回家关你什么事情！扫兴。”
贺娅娇就不爽张逸风那一副不近人情的脸，而且自己凭什么跟你回家？你当你是谁啊。又不是我男朋友。
“张逸风，你来了就算了，但别找事情。娇娇，来，我们继续喝。”
章笑天不爽地声音传来，说着，他歌也不唱了，继续陪贺娅娇喝酒。
包间里除却贺娅娇外，还有几个女的，但这几个公子哥，只敬贺娅娇酒，贺娅娇这傻乎乎的直性格居然来者不拒。
张逸风摇了摇头，心想你又不是陪酒小姐，这么卖力干什么。难道不知道一旦等你喝多了，就极有可能发生一些无法挽回，后悔终生的事情吗？
张逸风虽然来了，却被这个圈子孤立在外，没有人理会他，也没有人敬他酒，反而是时不时会传来一些嘲笑声。
“杜少，原来他就是我们大学的张逸风啊，真是闻名不如见面。”
“呵呵，他真的那里有问题吗？”
张逸风并没有生气，就那么安静坐在角落，等着贺娅娇唱歌结束。

"Hmph, isn't mine too big and curled up?" Jiang Feng snorted pretending to be dissatisfied.
Xiao Bing patted Jiang Feng's ass, and then said: "Of course yours is the most perky, otherwise, how could I let you follow me? Let me pat it hard tonight."

Zhang Yifeng came to the third floor and quickly found private room 666, which was quite familiar.
Zhang Yifeng knocked on the door symbolically, then pushed the door open and entered.
In the private room, someone was singing "I Want to Love You to Death" at the top of his lungs. The sound really touched Zhang Yifeng's ears.
Fortunately, not long after he came in, the ear-piercing voice stopped.
"Zhang Yifeng, why are you here?"
Zhang Xiaotian's surprised voice came. The person holding the microphone was none other than Zhang Xiaotian.
"Is Zhang Yifeng here? Come, drink, drink."
On the sofa, He Yajiao also spoke. She was lying on the sofa. Even if the light in the private room was dim, Zhang Yifeng could tell that she had indeed drunk too much.
Next to He Yajiao, two men were sitting. Although Zhang Yifeng was not familiar with these two men, he still knew who they were.
Du Shao, Du Jian.
Qi Shao, Yang Liangqi.
These two people are both locals of Hangyang City. In this private room, these two people have the most energy. There were two other men whom Zhang Yifeng didn't recognize. They might be their friends or younger brothers.
These men were working together to drink from He Yajiao.
He Yajiao was obviously too drunk. When she saw Zhang Yifeng, she had some difficulty getting up, and finally staggered to Zhang Yifeng's side.
"Zhang Yifeng, didn't you say you wouldn't come? You nuisance, what are you doing here? But you came just in time, drink...drink! Three drinks as a punishment."
Zhang Yifeng frowned slightly, supported He Yajiao, who was staggering, and said calmly: "It's getting late, you've almost finished drinking, it's time to go home."
He Yajiao frowned when he heard this: "You don't drink? Then what are you doing here? It's none of your business whether I go home or not! It's disappointing."
He Yajiao is dissatisfied with Zhang Yifeng's inhumane face, and why should she go home with you? Who do you think you are? Not my boyfriend.
"Zhang Yifeng, forget it if you come, but don't make trouble. Jiaojiao, come, let's continue drinking."
Zhang Xiaotian's unhappy voice came. As he spoke, he stopped singing and continued drinking with He Yajiao.
In addition to He Yajiao, there were several other women in the private room, but these gentlemen only offered He Yajiao wine. He Yajiao, with his silly and straightforward personality, actually refused to accept anyone who came.
Zhang Yifeng shook his head, thinking that you are not a bartender, why are you working so hard. Don’t you know that once you drink too much, something irreversible and something you will regret for the rest of your life is very likely to happen?
Although Zhang Yifeng came, he was isolated from this circle. No one paid attention to him, and no one toasted him. Instead, there would be some ridicule from time to time.
"Master Du, it turns out he is Zhang Yifeng from our university. He is so famous that it is better to meet him."
"Haha, does he really have a problem?"
Zhang Yifeng was not angry, and just sat quietly in the corner, waiting for He Yajiao to finish singing.
